feature.title: Fix router * guard never triggered + go() updates _current before guard check

tasks.title: Fix router go() to check wildcard * guard as fallback
tasks.description: In router.js go(), guards are checked only against `resolved.pattern` (e.g., '/settings'). The `*` wildcard guard registered via `router.guard('*', fn)` is stored under key `'*'` but never matched because no route pattern compiles to `'*'`. Fix: after checking the specific pattern guard, also check the `*` global guard if it exists. Guard order: specific pattern first, then `*` fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: router.guard('*', fn) guard fires for EVERY route navigation
Specific pattern guard fires before * guard
If specific guard returns false, * guard NOT checked (first rejection wins)
If specific guard returns true or doesn't exist, * guard checked as fallback
Guard receives correct { from, to, params } at both levels
Existing guard in app.js:149 now correctly blocks unauthenticated navigation
Hash change events also trigger guard check (via go() called from hashchange handler)

tasks.title: Fix go() _current assignment before guard check
tasks.description: In router.js go(), `_current = path` is set at line 102 BEFORE the guard check at line 96. But looking more carefully: the guard check at line 96 DOES happen before line 102. Actually re-reading the code: the guard check at lines 95-99 happens BEFORE `_current = path` at line 102. This is correct. The FRAMEWORK_PATTERNS.md line 292 claims `go() updates _current before guard check` — this is a documentation bug, not a code bug. Update FRAMEWORK_PATTERNS.md to remove incorrect claim. Add test to verify ordering.
acceptanceCriteria: Verified: _current NOT updated when guard rejects navigation
guard rejection returns false without mutating _current or updating hash
